req.title: Reject wrong method on /delete
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than DELETE on /delete.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /delete endpoint should only accept DELETE requests and return a 405 Method Not Allowed for any other HTTP methods. This ensures that the endpoint is used correctly and prevents misuse by other HTTP methods. The test suite will include a positive test for the DELETE method, a negative test for a non-DELETE method, and a boundary test for an edge case method like OPTIONS.

tests.name: test_delete_method_allowed
actions: Send a DELETE request to the /delete endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.delete('/delete')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_get_method_not_allowed
actions: Send a GET request to the /delete endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/delete')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_options_method_not_allowed
actions: Send an OPTIONS request to the /delete endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.options('/delete')
assert response.status_code == 405
